# persistence-drizzle

> A typed Drizzle ORM database over any SQLite driver: one FIFO lock serializing every statement, BEGIN IMMEDIATE
> transactions that hold it, drizzle-kit migrations at open that refuse unknown or drifted state, typed Preferences
> and a hardened export envelope. Drivers for Capacitor SQLite and node:sqlite.

## Docs

- [Documentation site](https://jonbogaty.com/persistence-drizzle/): the published, browsable version of everything below.
- [README](https://github.com/jbcom/persistence-drizzle/blob/main/README.md): install, quick start, API overview, rules.
- [API reference](https://github.com/jbcom/persistence-drizzle/blob/main/docs/API.md): signatures and failure behavior of every export.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/jbcom/persistence-drizzle/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): the lock, transaction and migration invariants.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/jbcom/persistence-drizzle/blob/main/AGENTS.md): toolchain, invariants not to violate, and doc/test sync obligations.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jbcom/persistence-drizzle/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): local setup, the `pnpm verify` gate, commit and release conventions.
